# ft8 test data

`fuzz/` holds Go fuzz corpus entries generated in this repository.

No off-air recordings are committed. The ft8_lib test recordings used during
development (see docs/decisions/0008-own-ft8-decoder.md) are kept outside the
repository. If any are added here, they come from ft8_lib
(https://github.com/kgoba/ft8_lib), Copyright (c) 2018 Kārlis Goba, under the
MIT licence: note which files they are in this README and keep
[../LICENSE.ft8_lib](../LICENSE.ft8_lib) alongside them.
